description: GetQueryTrafficStats + GetPageStats + GetPageQueryStats + GetQueryPageStats + GetQueryPageDetailStats: per-query and per-page search-performance detail for a project's matched Bing site. FREE (no credits). pageStats (site-wide, weekly) is always attempted. queryTrafficStats/queryPageStats are null unless `query` is given; pageQueryStats is null unless `pageUrl` is given; queryPageDetailStats is null unless both are given — a null section absent from `errors` was not requested, not a failure. pageStats carries one unresolved caveat: Microsoft's own doc page is internally inconsistent about whether that method's `query` field on each row holds a query string or a page URL — surfaced as-is. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

pageUrl.description: The page to fetch query stats for. Required for pageQueryStats (and, with query, queryPageDetailStats).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

query.description: The search query to fetch traffic/page stats for. Required for queryTrafficStats/queryPageStats (and, with pageUrl, queryPageDetailStats).

name: get_bing_detail_stats
